records.adapted_prompt: Let P be the 2×2 matrix with rows (1, 3) and (2, −5), and Q have rows (3, −7) and (1, 2). What is P+2Q?
A bird travels 200 km from P to Q on a bearing of N60°E, then travels from Q to R on a bearing of S30°E. If R is due east of P, how far is Q from R?
